title: Exact pullback shift from tensor with the translated unit
statement: Let f: Z -> Y be proper between Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in one localization universe, the recorded tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and derived pullback F [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Supply any strong monoidal structure on F, with inverse tensorator delta. Write c_X(K) for the explicit translated-unit isomorphism [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. There exist a coherent integer-shift structure s on F and an isomorphism e: F(O_Y[1]) -> O_Z[1] such that F with s is triangulated and, for every K in D(O_Y), s(1)_K is F(c_Y(K)^-1); delta_(O_Y[1],K); (e tensor id_(F K)); c_Z(F K). No tensorator-shift square is asserted.

source.place: Exact K-flat derived pullback; translated-unit construction of the parent plan (08EU)

proof.text:
Represent the unit by the structure sheaf in degree zero and its translate
by that complex translated by one. Termwise tensor pullback of this K-flat complex
is the structure sheaf of Z translated by one. The comparison with derived pullback
and the supplied monoidal unit isomorphism give e. On a K-flat complex P, rewrite
P[1] as O_Y[1] tensor P using the first-variable Koszul map and the left unitor.
Apply the supplied inverse tensorator and e, then undo this rewrite over Z. This
is the displayed composite. Naturality follows from the tensorator, Koszul map
and left unitor. Iterate this comparison for positive integers, use its inverse
for negative integers and the canonical zero comparison at zero. Associativity
of composition and the shift addition isomorphisms give the addition equations;
the zero equations are the unitor equations. Termwise tensor pullback takes the
mapping cone of a map of K-flat resolutions to its mapping cone. The translated
unit comparison identifies the third map, so the induced triangle is
distinguished. Descend through the K-flat localization; every distinguished
triangle is isomorphic to one of these cone triangles. This proves exactness for
this shift structure. The formula and coherence hold also for the zero complex
and the zero category on an empty scheme. No choice from this existence theorem
is used to define any data: the comparison above was constructed explicitly.

lean.statement: theorem exists_derivedPullback_tensorUnitShift {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)] : ∃ (sF : (derivedPullback f).CommShift ℤ) (e : (derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅ (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), letI := sF (derivedPullback f).IsTriangulated ∧ ∀ K : schemeDerivedCategory Y, ((derivedPullback f).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K = (derivedPullbackTensorUnitShiftIso f e K).hom
